title: Codex skill id desc hard-limit enforce at export layer only
desc: Codex silently SKIPS any skill whose exported id over 64 or desc over 1024 chars. Enforce at the .codex export layer only (SkillCommand.AiExport.cs), NEVER on the internal contribute/edit save -- that broke persistence (2026-06-07). Resolution is prefix-64 tolerant; existing long ids never renamed.
steps: Codex SKIPS any exported skill with id over 64 or desc over 1024 chars -- silent, no error.

ENFORCE AT EXPORT LAYER ONLY (AiExport.cs on skill read). NEVER gate the internal save -- 2026-06-07 EnsureCodexUniqueId+CodexDescError in contribute made skills print Created but never write to disk; reverted.
id over 64 export: id=first60+dash+3char-hash; tail tokens to exported tags. desc over 1024: full desc to body section 0 with pointer wkappbot skill read id --if-newer (commit 11f6940ec).
Resolution matches on first-64-chars so truncated refs still resolve; never rename existing ids (links survive).
Storage: contribute writes {cwd}/skills (git-tracked); skill install copies to HQ; live catalog reads HQ.
